The '''Norkronia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] regions known as the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[the Negs]]. It was connected to the [[Alland system/Legends|Alland]] and [[Metellos system/Legends|Metellos systems]] by the [[Metellos Trade Route/Legends|Metellos Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]],<ref name="TEA" /> and was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Norkronian whistle-snake]]s.<ref name="SW49" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Norkronia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-10.<ref name="TEA" />
